text_block_list.name: TV Personality
text_block_list.text: "Happy New Year~!"

"On the TV, celebrities dressed in 
gorgeous kimonos are celebrating the New 
Year."
choice_data_list: It really feels like New Year's...

text_block_list.text:
I hear some teams forfeit their New
Year's 
break to train if they have races 
scheduled early in the year, but...
choice_data_list: It really feels like New Year's...

text_block_list.text:
Thinking I might go pick up something for 
dinner tonight, I slipped on my coat and 
stepped outside—
choice_data_list: Usually that'd be a day off, right?
Usually that'd be a day off, would...

text_block_list.text:
Fenomeno, who was supposed to be on her 
day off, was standing at the school gate.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year!
choice_data_list: Why are you here!?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Hah! The New Year holidays are precisely 
when many students let loose and get out 
of hand!
choice_data_list: Why are you here?!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"Then I judged that even if I am alone, I 
should place the area on high alert."
choice_data_list: Even if I have to go alone...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Sir!! As for the Disciplinary Committee's 
policy, there was a notice directly from 
the chairwoman to build up our strength.
choice_data_list: Saying 'even if it's just this off...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"However, to maintain order at the 
academy, at least one of us needs to be 
strict—"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
......Boss? Um, your face looks like a 
demon――
choice_data_list: When it's time to rest, you should...
When it's time to rest, you should...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Huh—
choice_data_list: When it's time to rest, you need t...
When it's time to rest, you should...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...Um. Boss. I appreciate your 
hospitality, but...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Even I can handle grilling mochi. Could 
you give me some work soon...?
choice_data_list: No. First, let's warm up your chil...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...Understood...!
choice_data_list: No. First, warm up your cold body.

text_block_list.text:
I took the mochi out of the oven and 
placed it onto Fenomeno's plate.
choice_data_list: Is there anything else you'd like ...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Huh? Simmered carrots...?
choice_data_list: Is there anything else you'd like ...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: No, no, no!!?? Not that far!!
choice_data_list: Got it. I'll get it ready, so wait...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
choice_data_list: At least enjoy your time off for N...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

"Even so, it'd probably be better for her 
to spend time with kids her own age
rather 
than staying with me. If there are any 
Umamusume at the academy, maybe I could 
invite them too—"
choice_data_list: Quietly taking care of your nails,...
Let's relax and enjoy New Year's.
Testing New Year's Luck with Sugoroku

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Grooming, you say?
choice_data_list: Maybe quietly grooming your nails ...
Let's enjoy a relaxing New Year's.
Testing New Year's Luck with Sugoroku

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Well? It's clear gel, but pretty cute, 
right? Gets you hyped, don't it?

Tosen Jordan is a trendy gal Umamusume 
from three generations above.
Her nail art 
skills are top-notch.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Splendid!
It doesn't stick out by even 0.5 
mm...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Yay. So? Next up is Fenomeno-san?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes! Please do!!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Fuha, you're so stiff, it's cute~ Gonna 
glitter you all up.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Wha-!? Such a flamboyant appearance...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Clear protective nail polish is totally 
fine with school rules, right?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
If you're that worried, I'll just do a 
pedicure. I'll make Miss Disciplinary 
Committee Member's toes look insanely 
cute.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: C-Cu...!? I am—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Sooo cuuute.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Stuff like this is all about hyping 
yourself up mentally, right? Don't you 
think, Trainer?"
choice_data_list: Phenomeno is so cute!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Boss!?
choice_data_list: Fenomeno is so cute!

text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Fenomeno spent more time 
fidgeting while staring at her toenails.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...It is beautiful, sir!

"And so, we called over the Umamusume 
inside the school building and gathered 
everyone to share a New Year's meal."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for inviting me! Is this... 
osechi?

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text:
Your Highness, allow me to test it for 
poison...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh! It's totally fine! I ate it and I was 
completely okay!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Then I shall test the rest of the food
for 
poison! Excuse me!!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
You should relax too, Fenomeno-san. Isn't 
the Japanese New Year meant to be spent 
taking it easy?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
That's right!
Spending Japanese New Year's 
together makes us just like family!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Family...!? We're becoming a family...?!

Those who came to the room were Fine 
Motion, a noble horse girl from a certain 
country, and Daring Heart, an American 
horse girl.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Fenomeno-senpai! Let's go on the New 
Year's shrine visit together! All of us!

And then there's the energetic, valiant 
sprint Umamusume—Biko Pegasus.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...Biko-san, challenging the New Year's 
shrine visit means charging straight into 
a massive crowd...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"You must definitely never let go of Big 
Sis Meno's hand! This is standard kidnap 
prevention protocol!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Big sis Meno?!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Fenomeno-san is quite interesting. 
In ways we seem alike... and in ways we 
aren'tâª
choice_data_list: "Not the same"?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. When it comes to protecting others, 
she can become stronger than anyone.
Plus, 
she has an unbreakable spirit.
choice_data_list: "Not the same"?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Yet she is someone unafraid of change. I 
wonder if she knows that even with the 
passage of time, she will never lose 
herself."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Even though we share a similar 
sensation, it feels like we're conversing 
in different languages.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
? We should be speaking the same language 
right now, but...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that serious side of yours too! 
You're just like them... and yet not at 
all!

And so, I spent New Year's with the 
energetic Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: And? What are you betting?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Gambling is a crime!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Haha, just kidding, just kidding. 
...You're so stiff.
choice_data_list: Then if I lose, lunch is on me.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Boss!?
choice_data_list: Then if I lose, dinner's on me.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, not bad. Coming up with a legal 
proposal... Guess your Trainer really 
knows their stuff, huh, Meno?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Deal. Tonight, we're having top-grade 
sushi at a traditional restaurant. On 
Meno's Trainer's tab."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: —Hm.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
The Boss won't lose!
This person is strong 
at board games as well!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Right, Boss?!
choice_data_list: Aaargh!!
Yeah!!

text_block_list.text:
And so the Sugoroku showdown began! Who 
will claim victory and win dinner—
choice_data_list: Yeah!!
Yeah!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
N-Nakayama-san,
wait! If you take one more 
step—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Why not make your move? ...Checkmate.
choice_data_list: U... Uwaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Booooooossssss——!!
choice_data_list: U-Uwaaaaaah!

text_block_list.text:
Though we were soundly defeated in the 
end, we continued playing happily with 
Fenomeno and the others until dinner time.
